fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Hazle Township, 100 Timberline Dr, Humboldt Industrial Park. ~1.19M sq ft, $440M investment, opened March 2022 - one of Niagara's largest plants (purified water + aseptic beverages). Confirmed via web search and satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Could not positively confirm a barrier/gate structure - the truck driveway is private and not covered by Street View, and satellite resolution at the SW approach is insufficient to resolve a barrier. Set true as a strong inference: a 1.19M sq ft / $440M secured manufacturing campus with a long private set-back approach is invariably gated. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively identified in imagery. Set true as standard for a Niagara plant of this scale (the SW corner office structure plausibly houses security), but flagged uncertain - this is an inference, not a confirmed visual.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two very long dock faces (NW and SW/SE), each with continuous dock-door rhythm and full trailer rows; estimate ~120 doors total, firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Heavy trailer drop yards on both the NW and SE faces with multiple rows of parked trailers; firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters on different building faces (NW and SW/SE) - consistent with separate shipping/receiving operations; flagged uncertain as the operational split cannot be confirmed from imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons and a long private approach driveway leave ample room to add a bypass / express lane; flagged uncertain pending gate confirmation.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Driveway width supports ~2 inbound lanes; estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~665m N-S x ~760m E-W); ~110 acres - large campus parcel including yards and buffer.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
